title: 開いたダーツ収納キャビネット
description: 交流施設やラウンジの壁へ掛ける、開いたダーツ盤収納キャビネット。放射状の色分けターゲット、実形状の細い区切り線、固定した両開き扉と無地の記録面、蝶番、収納棚と三本の固定ダーツ、背面壁取付部を造形。点数数字・ブランド・得点処理はありません。盤とダーツを含む一式で1点です。壁の設置高さは利用側で調整します。投擲・判定・扉操作や実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.940 × 0.810 × 0.430 m、20,304三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An open wall-mounted dartboard cabinet for community facilities and lounges. It includes a radially segmented color target, modeled fine divider wires, fixed open doors with blank scoring surfaces, hinges, storage shelf, three parked darts and rear wall fittings. Score numerals, brands and scoring logic are absent. Board and darts count as one cabinet assembly. Set wall placement height in the scene. Throwing, hit detection, door motion and real equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.940 × 0.810 × 0.430 m; 20,304 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
